offering_description.value: Graco designs and manufactures equipment that pumps, meters, mixes, dispenses, and sprays fluids and other materials. It serves painting and construction contractors, do-it-yourself users, paint retailers, manufacturers, and maintenance operations through distributors, dealers, and retailers.

primary_products.value: Paint and coating sprayers and line stripers; metering, mixing, and dispensing systems; fluid transfer pumps; lubrication equipment; powder coating systems

customer_segment.value: B2B: Painting and construction contractors, paint retailers, manufacturers, vehicle service shops, and industrial maintenance teams; B2C: Homeowners and do-it-yourself painters; B2G: Municipal public works and road maintenance departments

end_markets.value: Construction and property maintenance; industrial manufacturing; paint retail; vehicle servicing; road and pavement maintenance

revenue_model.value: product sales: Equipment, accessories, and replacement parts

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: Turns purchased materials and components into equipment sold through channel partners to contractors, retailers, and industrial users

geography_served.value: global: North America, Latin America, Europe, Asia-Pacific, the Middle East, and Africa

specialization.value: related lines: Coating application, fluid transfer, metering and dispensing, paint tinting, and lubrication equipment

distribution_channels.value: distributors / dealers: Industrial equipment distributors and specialist dealers serving contractors, manufacturers, and maintenance operations; third-party retail: Paint stores and home improvement chains; online: E-commerce sites operated by retailers and equipment dealers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: Manufacturing operations subject to workplace safety and environmental rules, with equipment safety standards in applicable markets

notes: It is unclear whether Graco sells repair or training services directly.
